compatibilityConflicts.APPROVED_GOVERNANCE_EXPECTATION: Separate external login principal may assume exactly its governed NOLOGIN authorization role

ROLE_MEMBERSHIP_QUERY.SQL: SELECT granted.rolname AS granted_role, member.rolname AS member_role FROM pg_catalog.pg_auth_members m JOIN pg_catalog.pg_roles granted ON granted.oid = m.roleid JOIN pg_catalog.pg_roles member ON member.oid = m.member WHERE granted.rolname = ANY($1::text[]) OR member.rolname = ANY($1::text[]) ORDER BY granted_role, member_role;

SELECT granted.rolname AS granted_role, member.rolname AS member_role FROM pg_catalog.pg_auth_members m JOIN pg_catalog.pg_roles granted ON granted.oid = m.roleid JOIN pg_catalog.pg_roles member ON member.oid = m.member WHERE granted.rolname = ANY($1::text[]) OR member.rolname = ANY($1::text[]) ORDER BY granted_role, member_role;

compatibilityConflicts.WHY_METADATA_ONLY_IS_INSUFFICIENT: A login principal delegated to an authorization role is a member of that role. The accepted descriptor contract rejects memberRoles in addition to memberships; its recorded query includes either direction. Passing an empty memberRoles projection would hide actual catalog state and is not an honest alignment.
compatibilityConflicts.PROVISIONING_PHASE_SEPARATION: Zero memberships can be valid before W8 login delegation. It is not a post-delegation verification contract. Existing artifacts do not explicitly establish a distinct pre-delegation verifier boundary plus governed post-delegation verifier.
REQUIRED_BOUNDED_AUTHORIZATION: Permit an explicit lifecycle boundary: W3 verifier is pre-delegation only and W8 must implement a separate exact post-delegation verifier before runtime acceptance
Or permit a scoped verifier/spec/test change allowing only the explicitly bound direct login-to-authorization membership, with no admin option, cross-scope/runtime-to-migration/nested delegation
